Its privacy policy (updated 24 Sep 2026) says WhatsApp and call conversations are logged "so our team can follow up" and that sales calls are recorded. The site scripts were revised on 24 Sep 2026, so someone is actively building. A team that built this may already have, or be building, WhatsApp automation, which would overlap with our "one lead board" and perhaps the first reply. The 8 staffed sales lines suggest a human telesales team that may answer fast. The scout's claim of no official website was wrong. The scout's Upvan unit count (586, 0 booked) did not show up in my GujRERA fetch.
data.ability_to_pay: Medium-high. Four concurrent projects, a newly launched large Upvan scheme, paid Meta ads across several placements, a custom-built CRM and ad-conversion pipeline. Against that: the LLP is only about 2 years old, ad spend is not visible, and the Ad Library shows no ads from this page before 29 Sep 2026.

The decision-maker is not named and the only direct routes are a shared Gmail enquiry inbox, a vendor application form, and sales lines that sit inside the lead flow they pay for. Pitch as a layer that plugs into their CRM, not a replacement, or the "we already have a CRM" objection ends it.

Sandalwood sits in a JV with other partners. 5) Marketing claims run ahead of the record, which suggests puffery and possible sensitivity. Pride Aura is a real, RERA-registered project (268 flats and 154 shops, approved 2025-04-25, completion 2029-12-31). The promoter is an established local family firm group with a named decision-maker. Ticket size is large: a third-party listing puts a 3 BHK at about Rs 70-75 lakh. They have no website and the project's own social pages are tiny (project Facebook page 1 follower, Instagram 14 followers, YouTube 11 subscribers), so paid WhatsApp taps and phone calls look like the main enquiry channel. That fits an instant reply with brochure, BHK and budget questions, site-visit booking and one lead board. The ad copy literally says "Created By AI", so they are unlikely to be anti-AI. data.case_against: The need is inferred, not observed. I found no review, complaint or other evidence of slow replies, and I cannot test for an auto-reply because contacting them is not allowed. Three loose ends: (1) the Facebook page "Pride Group" is linked to the promoter Pride Realtors only through the project name, location and the shared enquiry number, with no document that names the page owner; (2) there are two different numbers (76111 52111 in the ads and YouTube, 76004 00352 on the Facebook page), and I cannot tell which one the WhatsApp button opens; (3) the page intro talks about shops and offices while the ads sell 3 and 4 BHK flats, and the third-party listings show only 3 BHK, which looks like loose, unpolished marketing.
